candidates.name: Lymphoma
support_spans: nearly absent breath sounds on the right side
Pleural fluid analysis showed: Leukocyte count: 9.6 × 10⁹/L with 96% lymphocytes
candidates.why: Progressive dyspnea and pleural effusion with lymphocytic predominance suggest a lymphoproliferative disorder

candidates.name: Castleman disease
support_spans: Mediastinal, bilateral hilar, cardiophrenic angle, retrocrural, and retroperitoneal adenopathy
candidates.why: Multifocal lymphadenopathy and systemic symptoms like unintentional weight loss are consistent with Castleman disease

candidates.name: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
support_spans: Mix of small to large B lymphocytes
Aberrant expression of BCL2
Elevated Ki-67
candidates.why: The presence of a mix of small to large B lymphocytes and aberrant BCL2 expression suggest a lymphoma with a potential for aggressive behavior

candidates.name: Follicular lymphoma
support_spans: Pleural fluid analysis showed: Leukocyte count: 9.6 × 10⁹/L with 96% lymphocytes
candidates.why: The lymphocytic predominance in the pleural fluid and the absence of specific markers like CD5 and CD10 expression may suggest a follicular lymphoma

candidates.name: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma
support_spans: Endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration of station 4R and cervical lymph node biopsy showed: Mix of small to large B lymphocytes
candidates.why: The presence of a mix of small to large B lymphocytes and the absence of specific markers like CD5 and CD10 expression may suggest a nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, which would be confirmed by the presence of lymphocytic and histiocytic (L&H) cells

candidates.name: Primary effusion lymphoma
support_spans: Pleural fluid analysis showed: Leukocyte count: 9.6 × 10⁹/L with 96% lymphocytes
Cholesterol level: 1.79 mmol/L (69 mg/dL)
candidates.why: The presence of a high lymphocyte count in the pleural fluid and the absence of systemic symptoms may suggest a primary effusion lymphoma, which would be confirmed by the presence of lymphoma cells in the pleural fluid
